title: Computer-aided diagnosis using embedded ensemble deep learning for multiclass drug-resistant tuberculosis classification.
summary: An ensemble of three CNNs classifies drug-resistant TB on 5,039 chest X-rays with an 80/20 split and a further 760-image check, reaching 93.4% test accuracy, plus a usability study with 33 staff. This is a retrospective diagnostic validation of a specific clinical classifier. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
